test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which among the following is NOT a use of sodium hydroxide?

(i) Used in making soaps and detergents.

(ii) Used in the manufacture of paper.

(iii) Used for removing permanent hardness of water.
solution:
The correct answer is** __'Only iii'__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium hydroxide** is a highly versatile substance and is a **co-product of chlorine production**.
 
• It is also known as **caustic soda**. It is represented as **NaOH.**
 
• It is one of the common alkalis or bases.
 
• It is used for various purposes in daily life, as it is a strong base.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uses of sodium hydroxide:**

 
 
• It is used in the **manufacturing of detergents and soaps.**
 
• It is used in the production of bleach-like chlorine.
 
• It is used in drain cleaners.
 
• It is used in the** removal of heavy metals from the water** by the municipal water treatment facility.
 
• It is used in food preservatives to prevent bacteria and mould growth.
 
• It is used for canning.
 
• It is used in **papermaking and paper recycling.**​
